description: This file defines the BlobReporter class, a test report generator that creates ZIP reports with metadata, attachments, and test results for Playwright testing framework.

classes.name: BlobReporter
classes.description: A class that generates ZIP reports for Playwright tests, including metadata, attachments, and test results.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes BlobReporter with options, validates filename, and generates a GUID salt.

methods.name: onConfigure
methods.description: Sets up report metadata and stores configuration.

methods.name: onTestPaused
methods.description: No-op; relevant only for interactive use, not for blob replays.

methods.name: onEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the report by creating a ZIP file with metadata, attachments, and test results.

methods.name: _prepareOutputFile
methods.description: Prepares the output file path, removing old reports if necessary, and creates directories.

methods.name: _defaultReportName
methods.description: Generates default report filename based on options and configuration.

methods.name: _serializeAttachments
methods.description: Serializes attachments, adding a hash-based filename and storing original paths.
